title: NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Isolation and RNA Library Prep Protocol
author: New England Biolabs
materials: NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module
NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina

To wash the Oligo dT Beads, add the following to a 1.5 ml nuclease-free tube. If preparing multiple libraries, beads for up to 10 samples can be added to a single 1.5 ml tube for subsequent washes (use magnet NEB #S1506 for 1.5 ml tubes). The purpose of this step is to bring the beads from the storage buffer into the binding buffer. The 2X Binding Buffer does not have to be diluted for this step.
Proceed directly to Second Strand cDNA Synthesis.

[ ! ] Dilute the NEBNext Adaptor* prior to setting up the ligation reaction in ice-cold Adaptor Dilution Buffer and keep the adaptor on ice. Total RNA Input Dilution Required 1,000 ng–101 ng 5–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 100 ng–10 ng 25–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 5 ng 200–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer *The NEBNext adaptor is provided in NEBNext oligos kit. NEB has several oligo kit options, which are supplied separately from the library prep kit. Please see www.neb.com/oligos for additional information.
Proceed immediately to Purification of the Ligation Reaction.

[ ! ] Incubate the sample in a preheated thermocycler with the heated lid set at ≥ 80°C as follows: Note: If you are following recommendations in the Appendix ( manual ), for libraries with longer inserts (> 200 bases), increase the incubation at 42 °C from 15 minutes to 50 minutes at Step 2 below. Step 1: 00:10:00 at 25 °C Step 2: 00:15:00 at 42 °C Step 3: 00:15:00 at 70 °C Step 4: Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare First Strand Synthesis Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the First Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer and Random Primer Mix in a nuclease-free microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Keep the mix on ice until mRNA purification is complete.

steps.title: Dilute Total RNA
steps.instruction: Dilute the total RNA with nuclease-free water to a final volume of 50 µL in a nuclease-free 0.2 ml PCR tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare and Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the beads for RNA binding through a series of washes.

substeps.instruction: Wash the beads by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Place the tube on the magnet and incubate at room temperature until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Remove and discard all supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Add 100 µL RNA Binding Buffer (2X) (or 100 µL per sample for multiple libraries) and wash by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Place tubes on the magnet and incubate at room temperature until clear (~2 minutes).
Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Bind mRNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the target mRNA to the prepared beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL RNA Binding Buffer (2X) (or 50 µL per sample) to the beads and mix by pipetting up and down until homogenous.
Add 50 μl of the prepared beads to each RNA sample from the dilution step.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Heat the sample in a thermocycler at 65 °C for 5 minutes, then cool to 4 °C (heated lid set at ≥ 75 °C).
Remove the tube when the temperature reaches 4 °C.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes to allow mRNA binding.

steps.title: Wash Bound mRNA
steps.instruction: Remove unbound RNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack at room temperature until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Remove and discard all supernatant.
Add 200 µL of Wash Buffer and gently pipette up and down 6 times to mix.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack at room temperature until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Remove and discard all supernatant.
Repeat the wash process (adding 200 µL Wash Buffer, mixing, and magnetic separation) one more time.

steps.title: Perform First mRNA Elution
steps.instruction: Perform an initial elution of mRNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl of Tris Buffer (NEB #E7490 kit) to each tube and gently pipette up and down 6 times.
Heat the samples in a thermocycler at 80 °C for 2 minutes, then cool to 25 °C (heated lid set at ≥ 90 °C).
Remove the tube when the temperature reaches 25 °C.

steps.title: Re-bind and Final Wash of mRNA
steps.instruction: Re-bind the mRNA to the beads for final purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl of RNA Binding Buffer (2X) to the sample and mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of Wash Buffer and gently pipette up and down 6 times.
Briefly spin down the tube to collect liquid from the walls and lid.
Place the tube on the magnet until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Remove all supernatant using a 10 μl tip, taking care not to disturb the beads. Spin down the tube.

steps.title: Elute and Fragment mRNA
steps.instruction: Elute the mRNA and fragment it using heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 11.5 µL of the First Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer and Random Primer Mix (2X) and pipette up and down 6 times to resuspend beads.
Incubate in a preheated thermocycler (heated lid at 105 °C) at 94 °C for 15 minutes, then hold at 4 °C.
Immediately transfer the tube to ice for 1 minute once it cools to ~65 °C.
Quickly spin down the tube and place on the magnet until the solution is clear (1–2 minutes).
Transfer 10 µL of the supernatant to a nuclease-free 0.2 ml PCR tube. If volume is < 10 μl, bring it up to 10 μl using the First Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer and Random Primer Mix.
Place the tube on ice.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize the first strand of cDNA on ice.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the reaction by adding: 10 µl Fragmented and Primed RNA, 8 µl NEBNext Strand Specificity Reagent (#E7766), and 2 µl NEBNext First Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (#E7761) for a total volume of 20 µl.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize the second strand of cDNA on ice.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the reaction by adding: 20 µl First Strand Synthesis Product, 8 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer with dUTP (10X, #E7426), 4 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (#E7425), and 48 µl Nuclease-free Water (#E7764) for a total volume of 80 µl.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times while keeping the tube on ice.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 1 hour at 16 °C (heated lid at 40 °C or off).

steps.title: Purify Second Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (#E7767) by vortexing.
Add 144 µL (1.8X) of resuspended beads to the 80 µL reaction and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x).
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Briefly spin the tube and place on a magnet; discard the supernatant once clear.
Add 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the rack, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Air-dry the beads on the magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).
Remove from rack and elute by adding 53 µL 0.1X TE Buffer (#E7763). Mix well (vortex or pipette 10x).
Quickly spin and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on the magnetic rack until clear and transfer 50 µL of the supernatant to a clean nuclease-free PCR tube.

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform end preparation of the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the reaction on ice: 50 µl Second Strand Synthesis Product, 7 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (#E7647), and 3 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (#E7646) for a total volume of 60 µl.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 50 μl.
Perform a quick spin.
Incubate in a thermocycler (heated lid ≥ 75 °C): 30 minutes at 20 °C, then 30 minutes at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate adaptors to the end-prepped DNA.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the reaction on ice: 60 µl End Prepped DNA, 2.5 µl Diluted Adaptor, 1 µl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer (#E7374), and 30 µl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (#E7648) for a total volume of 93.5 µl.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 80 μl.
Perform a quick spin.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 20 °C in a thermocycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the ligated product with USER enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL NEBNext USER Enzyme (#E7458) to the ligation mixture (total volume 96.5 µL).
Mix well and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes (heated lid ≥ 45 °C).

steps.title: Size Selection and Purification
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 87 µL (0.9X) resuspended NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (#E7767) and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x).
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Quickly spin and place on a magnetic rack; discard the supernatant once clear (~5 minutes).
Add 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the rack, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Briefly spin and return to the magnetic rack.
Completely remove residual ethanol and air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from rack and elute by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE. Mix well, quickly spin, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on the magnet until clear and transfer 15 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube.

steps.title: PCR Enrichment
steps.instruction: Amplify the library via PCR based on the primer type used.

substeps.instruction: Set up the reaction: Option A (Separate Primers): 14 µl DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 5 µl Universal/i5 Primer, 5 µl Index/i7 Primer (50 µl total). Option B (Combined Primers): 15 µl DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 10 µl Index/Universal Primer Mix (50 µl total).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and quickly spin.

Perform PCR in a thermocycler (heated lid 105 °C): Initial Denaturation 98°C (30s, 1 cycle); Denaturation 98°C (10s, 8–16 cycles); Annealing/Extension 65°C (75s, 8–16 cycles); Final Extension 65°C (5 min, 1 cycle); Hold 4°C.
Adjust PCR cycles based on RNA input: 1,000 ng (7–8 cycles), 100 ng (11–12 cycles), 10 ng (11–12 cycles).

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup of the PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend NEBNext Sample Purification Beads by vortexing.
Add 45 µL (0.9X) of beads to the ~50 µL PCR reaction and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x).
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quickly spin and place on a magnetic rack; discard the supernatant once clear (~5 minutes).
Add 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the rack, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Air-dry the beads for up to 5 minutes on the magnetic rack (do not over-dry).
Remove from rack and elute by adding 23 µL 0.1X TE. Mix well (pipette 10x), quickly spin, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on the magnetic rack until clear and transfer 20 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube; store at –20°C.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify and check the size distribution of the library.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 µL of the library on a DNA 1000 chip (or DNA High Sensitivity chip if yield is low).
Verify the electropherogram shows a narrow distribution with a peak size of approximately 300 bp.
If peaks at ~80 bp or 128 bp are visible, bring sample volume to 50 μl with 0.1X TE and repeat the SPRIselect/NEBNext bead cleanup.
